title: Reset Card PIN

title: Unable to Withdraw and Transact
short_paraphrase: Diagnose activation, usable funds and card controls before replacement.
adoption_limit: Real-bank delivery and authentication channels are not adopted.

title: Lock your Card Temporarily using Payment Controls
short_paraphrase: Distinguish temporary protective controls from permanent cancellation.
adoption_limit: NovaBank action timings and token treatment are synthetic.

title: Overseas Card Transaction Fees
short_paraphrase: Separate settlement-date rates, merchant DCC and issuer charges.
adoption_limit: Do not import actual fee rates or refund conversion methods.

title: Transact & Withdraw in Foreign Currency Overseas
short_paraphrase: Distinguish purchase funding balances from overseas ATM funding.
adoption_limit: Actual supported currencies and balance selection differ from NovaBank.

title: Guide to Submit Card Transaction Dispute
short_paraphrase: Pending authorisation, settled disputes and duplicate recovery require separate handling.

title: ATM Help & Guides

title: ATM Security

adoption_limit: Do not transplant real-bank alert thresholds or product controls.

adoption_limit: Rolling and adaptive limits differ; retain NovaBank calendar-day/month caps.

title: My Card Deposit Did Not Work

title: Why Was My Top-Up Reverted?
short_paraphrase: Distinguish technical reversals from issuer-disputed funding.
adoption_limit: External dispute resolution has no guaranteed NovaBank completion deadline.

title: Lost or Stolen Card
short_paraphrase: Prompt loss reporting and replacement are distinct from transaction investigations.
adoption_limit: Actual liability and replacement charges are not adopted.

title: Lost or Stolen Device
short_paraphrase: Lost-device access recovery, session removal and transaction review.

title: Update Personal Details
short_paraphrase: Contact updates differ from legal identity changes and supporting-document updates.

title: Close a Current/Savings Account
short_paraphrase: Closure requires handling remaining balances, holds and linked facilities.
adoption_limit: Joint, loan-linked and branch closure services are excluded.

title: Made a Funds Transfer to a Wrong Recipient?
short_paraphrase: Completed-transfer recall needs receiving-side cooperation; recovery cannot be guaranteed.

title: Unsuccessful Fund Transfer to Another Bank Account
short_paraphrase: Wrong bank/account selection, inactive destinations and returned transfers.

title: My Single-Use Virtual Card Is Not Working

title: What Is a Virtual Card
short_paraphrase: Separate reusable from one-use credentials and protect access to card details.
adoption_limit: No India-specific service or product entitlement is adopted.

title: Deposit Cash
short_paraphrase: Cash deposit involves an actual accepting bank and an identifiable receipt.
adoption_limit: Reference comparison only: NovaBank accepts no physical cash.

title: Cheque Clearing
short_paraphrase: Deposit receipt, clearing and available funds are separate concepts.
adoption_limit: Reference comparison only: NovaBank accepts no cheques and quotes no clearing SLA.

title: Documents Required for Account Opening

title: Documents for Source of Funds Verification

title: Problems with a Refund

adoption_limit: NovaBank uses business-day clocks and its original-rate refund rule.
